design_philosophy.archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / MATURE HI-FI MUSIC PLATFORM
design_philosophy.core_concept: Editorial Spotify/TIDAL fusion with tactile 3D control elements, organic anthracite dark surfaces, and discrete BIOXIC cyan signal accents.
anti_patterns_banned: No sci-fi robots or futuristic space slop
No excessive neon cyan gradients or glowing webgl grids
No full-screen blur transparent glass over readable text
No generic AI-generated filler photos or fake artist images
No non-functional buttons or cramped mobile target areas
No Inter font on headlines or H1 font sizes above text-6xl

homepage.hero_section: Editorial hero showcase with featured music release or live video, high-contrast typography, 3D listen CTA, and official imagery
sections: Ultimele Lansări (Recent singles with vinyl deck hover effect)
Piese Populare (Stream deck table with track numbers, length, and playback trigger)
Videoclipuri Recente (Video hub grid with HD video preview cards)
BIOXIC TV Live Entry (Interactive banner leading to live channel with viewer count)
Albume și Colecții (Grid of square album artwork collections)
Acces Rapid (Quick links grid to all sections)

elements: Interactive progress seekbar with cyan indicator

tv_page.layout: Cinematic 16:9 video player frame with ambient glow, live chat sidebar, weekly TV schedule timetable tabs, premiere countdown timer

about_page.layout: Magazine-editorial spread with high-res studio photography, artist bio story, diskography milestones, discreet numerical statistics

images.usage: Hero featured album / studio mixing console banner
About section artist portrait & BIOXIC profile image

testing_requirements.data_testid_policy: All interactive elements (buttons, links, volume slider, play/pause controls, menu toggles, search input, track rows) MUST have clear kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='player-play-button', data-testid='track-row-1').

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Ensure Romanian language UI labels across all pages ('Ascultă acum', 'Ultimele lansări', 'Program TV', 'Piese populare', etc.).
Keep audio playback continuous during router navigation using a global persistent state.
Do NOT add heavy WebGL background canvas loops or heavy smooth-scroll libraries that tank FPS.
Mobile touch targets must be at least 44px by 44px with smooth bottom dock navigation.
